text: dsh-local-radiance-server-controller 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的局域网推理服务器控制面板，通过 SSH 连接 AMD 服务器并在侧边栏提供操作面板和实时状态挂件。用户可查看 CPU、GPU 与 Radiance 推理速度，启动或停止 Docker Compose 服务、更新镜像、调整 GPU 功率限制，并查看硬件信息。适合在 DSH 中管理自托管的 Radiance 推理主机；需要目标服务器的 SSH 地址与登录账号，指标读取服务器 Compose 配置中的 Radiance API 凭据。

A DSH web panel for managing a LAN AMD Radiance server over SSH. Start or stop its Compose service, update its image, adjust GPU power, and view CPU, GPU, and inference metrics in a sidebar widget. Requires the server SSH login; metrics use its Radiance API credential.
想从 DSH 面板远程启停局域网里的 Radiance 推理服务。
I want to check CPU, GPU, and inference throughput for my LAN server from DSH.
有没有办法在 DSH 里调整 AMD 显卡功率限制并查看服务器状态？
dsh-local-radiance-server-controller 的功能「推理服务」：在面板选择 Compose 文件并启停 Radiance，也可更新镜像或打开服务器网页。
dsh-local-radiance-server-controller 的功能「GPU 与实时状态」：侧边栏显示 CPU、GPU 和推理速度；面板可查看 amd-smi 信息并调整 GPU 功率上限。
dsh-local-radiance-server-controller 使用前须知：需要服务器 SSH 登录信息；指标读取远端 .env 中的 RADIANCE_API_KEY 来请求 Radiance /stats。

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · dsh-local-radiance-server-controller：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) plugin: remote-control an AMD inference server on your local LAN over SSH — the local Radiance inference server controller.

Adds a "推理服务器 / Inference Server" panel to the DSH sidebar plus an always-visible live-metrics widget in the sidebar footer, so day-to-day operations need no terminal.

Chinese documentation: [README.zh-CN.md](./README.zh-CN.md)

Sidebar entry and the always-live metrics widget (bottom of the sidebar):

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Features：| Card | What it does | Remote command |
|---|---|---|
| SSH settings | Host / port / username / password / compose directory / default service file / image name / power limit / sudo toggle | — (saved locally to `~/.dsh/dsh-local-radiance-server-controller.json`) |
| AMD GPU power limit | Enable limit / reset to default; shows current limit state; buttons get a ✓ and disable when the state already matches | `sudo amd-smi set -o <W>` / `sudo amd-smi reset -o` |
| Radiance inference service | Dropdown of yaml files in the compose directory (`common.yaml` hidden), start / stop / update image (down first, then pull); shows the running engine version; opens the engine web page in your default browser | `cd <dir> && sudo docker compose -f <file> up -d / down`; `sudo docker pull <image>`; web URL = `http://<host>:<PORT>` with PORT read from `<compose dir>/.env` |
| Server diagnostics | Fetch full amd-smi output | `amd-smi` |
| Danger zone | Shutdown / Reboot — each with its own two-click confirmation (auto-disarms after 4 s) | `sudo shutdown -h now` / `sudo reboot` |
| Sidebar widget | One persistent row: status dot + `GPU %` `CPU %`

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Features：Opening the panel probes the server immediately (running services, power-limit state), then refreshes every 20 s; every action also triggers an immediate refresh.

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Live metrics & connection architecture：The whole plugin keeps exactly **one long-lived SSH connection** to the server (15 s keepalive, self-healing reconnect with backoff). All traffic multiplexes over it through ssh2 exec channels:

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Live metrics & connection architecture：| Traffic | Cadence | Remote command |
|---|---|---|
| Engine decode/prefill | 0.5 s | `curl localhost:<PORT>/stats` (radiance Web API; PORT and API key are read on the fly from `<compose dir>/.env` — the key never leaves the server; the `version` field doubles as the engine-version display on the service card) |
| CPU / GPU utilization | 5 s | `/proc/stat` double-sample delta; `GFX_ACTIVITY` from `amd-smi metric -u` |
| Service / power state | 20 s | `docker compose ls --format json`; `amd-smi static -l` (SOCKET vs MAX power to detect an active limit) |
| User actions | on demand | see Features table |

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Live metrics & connection architecture：No short-lived connections: the server's `journalctl` typically shows only one or two SSH logins per day.

The sudo password is piped in via base64 (`base64 -d | sudo -S`); plaintext never appears in remote process arguments.

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Prerequisites：- This machine: DeepSeek Harness desktop
- Server: sshd with password login, sudo available (Radiance deployed via docker compose; AMD GPU with `amd-smi`; radiance engine exposing the `/stats` endpoint)

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Steps (first install on any machine)：1. **Copy the plugin directory** anywhere on the target machine (do **not** copy `node_modules`; reinstall dependencies per machine):
   You only need `index.js`, `client.js`, `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `icon.svg`, `locale/` (`assets/` is the README screenshot, optional).
2. **Install dependencies inside the plugin directory** (installing a local directory does not install its dependencies; skipping this fails with `Cannot find package 'node-ssh'`):
   ```bash
   cd <plugin dir>
   npm install --omit=dev
   ```
3. **Install the bundle into DSH**: tell the Harness agent
   > use plugin_manager to install `<absolute plugin dir>` as a bundle

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Steps (first install on any machine)：or run `dsh plugin install <absolute plugin dir>`.
4. **Restart the DSH app** (Host-side code loads at app start).
5. Open the sidebar panel, fill in the SSH details, save.

To sync between machines, copy the files listed in step 1 and repeat steps 2–3.

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Configuration：| Field | Notes | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Host / port / username / password | SSH login (the password is also used for sudo) | `22` |
| Compose directory | Directory containing the service yaml files (`~` allowed) | `~/radiance-compose` |
| Default compose file | Preselected service file in the panel | `flashnext-tp2.yaml` |
| Radiance image | Image pulled by the Update-image action | `stilldeadcode/radiance` |
| Power limit (W) | Target watts for the Enable-limit action | `210` |
| Use sudo | When off, commands run without sudo (the remote user needs direct docker/AMD permissions) | on |

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Configuration：> ⚠️ Security: the SSH password is stored **in plaintext** on this machine at `~/.dsh/dsh-local-radiance-server-controller.json`. Don't use this on shared/managed machines, and keep the account's permissions minimal.

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Errors or stale behavior after code edits | Restart the DSH app (Host module cache) |
| `sudo: a password is required` | Re-save the password in the panel (sudo uses the login password) |
| Widget shows `-` although the service is fine | Normal during the reconnect cooldown after a server reboot/disconnect; recovers within ~30 s |
| A yaml file missing from the dropdown | Only plain `.yaml/.yml` file names without `..` are listed; `common.yaml` is hidden on purpose |
| Decode reads 0/tiny while idle | Radiance reports a windowed engine-side average; idle is near zero by design |

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · File structure：```
dsh-local-radiance-server-controller/
├── index.js          # Host half: HTTP endpoints + SSH connection pool + all remote actions
├── client.js         # Client half: panel UI + sidebar icon + live metrics widget
├── cordis.patch.yml  # Loader patch (injects the plugin entry)

Host endpoints (prefix route on the local DSH web server, protected by DSH login):
`GET state`, `GET job?id`, `GET fast`, `POST settings`, `POST action {action,file?}`
under `/dsh-local-radiance-server-controller`.

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · dsh-local-radiance-server-controller：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：通过 SSH 远程控制局域网内的 AMD 推理服务器（本地 Radiance 推理服务器控制器）。

在 DSH 侧边栏提供「推理服务器」面板 + 侧栏底部常驻实时指标小部件，无需打开终端即可完成日常运维。

English documentation: [README.md](./README.md)

侧栏入口与常驻实时指标小部件（位于侧栏底部）：

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 功能：| 卡片 | 能力 | 远端实际执行 |
|---|---|---|
| SSH 连接设置 | 主机 / 端口 / 用户名 / 密码 / Compose 目录 / 默认服务文件 / 镜像名 / 功率值 / 是否 sudo | —（保存到本机 `~/.dsh/dsh-local-radiance-server-controller.json`） |
| AMD 显卡功率限制 | 开启限制 / 恢复默认，显示当前限制状态，按钮按实际状态打 ✓ 置灰 | `sudo amd-smi set -o <W>` / `sudo amd-smi reset -o` |
| Radiance 推理服务 | 下拉列出 Compose 目录下的 yaml（自动隐藏 `common.yaml`），启动 / 关闭 / 更新镜像（先 down 再 pull）；显示运行中的引擎版本号；一键用系统默认浏览器打开引擎 Web 页面 | `cd <dir> && sudo docker compose -f <file> up -d / down`；`sudo docker pull <image>`；Web 地址 = `http://<host>:<PORT>`（PORT 从 `<compose目录>/.env` 现场读取） |
| 服务器诊断 | 拉取 amd-smi 完整输出 | `amd-smi` |
| 危险操作 | 关机 / 重启（均为独立二次确认，4 秒超时自动解除） | `sudo shutdown -h now` / `sudo reboot` |
| 侧栏小部件 | 常驻一行：状态灯 + `GPU %` `CPU %` `解码 t/s` `预填 t/s`（侧栏收起时缩为状态圆点） | 见下方「实时指标」 |
dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 功能：打开面板即自动探测服务器状态（服务在跑与否、功率限制现状），此后每 20 秒刷新；执行任何操作后立即刷新。

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 实时指标与连接架构：全插件对服务器**只维持 1 条 SSH 长连接**（keepalive 15s，断线自愈 + 退避重连），四类流量通过 ssh2 的多路复用 exec 通道并行共用：

| 流量 | 周期 | 远端命令 |
|---|---|---|
| 引擎解码/预填充 | 0.5s | `curl localhost:<PORT>/stats`（radiance Web API，PORT 与 API key 从 `<compose目录>/.env` 现场读取，密钥不出服务器；响应里的 `version` 字段同时驱动服务卡片上的引擎版本显示） |
| CPU / GPU 占用 | 5s | `/proc/stat` 双采样差分；`amd-smi metric -u` 的 `GFX_ACTIVITY` |
| 服务/功率状态 | 20s | `docker compose ls --format json`；`amd-smi static -l`（对比 SOCKET/MAX 功率判断是否已限制） |
| 用户操作 | 按需 | 见功能表 |

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 实时指标与连接架构：不产生任何短连接；服务器端 `journalctl` 一天通常只有一两条 SSH 登录记录。

sudo 密码以 base64 管道注入（`base64 -d | sudo -S`），明文不出现在远端进程参数中。

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 前置条件：- 目标机器：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版
- 服务器：sshd 允许密码登录、sudo 可用（Radiance 部署为 docker compose；AMD GPU + `amd-smi`；radiance 引擎支持 `/stats` 接口）

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 步骤（首次在任何机器上安装）：1. **拷贝插件目录**到目标机器任意位置（不要拷贝 `node_modules`，跨机器请重装依赖）：
   只需 `index.js`、`client.js`、`package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`icon.svg`、`locale/`（`assets/` 是 README 配图，可选）。
2. **在插件目录内安装依赖**（本地目录安装不会自动装依赖，缺这步会报 `Cannot find package 'node-ssh'`）：
   ```bash
   cd <插件目录>
   npm install --omit=dev
   ```
3. **在 DSH 里安装 bundle**：对 Harness 里的智能体说
   > 用 plugin_manager 把 `<插件目录绝对路径>` 安装为 bundle
   或命令行：`dsh plugin install <插件目录绝对路径>`。
4. **重启一次 DSH 应用**（Host 侧代码需随应用启动加载）。
5. 打开侧栏「推理服务器」面板，填写 SSH 信息并保存即可。

text: dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 步骤（首次在任何机器上安装）：多台机器之间同步时，只需拷贝上面列出的文件/目录，重新执行第 2、3 步。
section: 步骤（首次在任何机器上安装）

text:
dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 配置项说明：| 字段 | 说明 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| 主机 IP / 端口 / 用户名 / 密码 | SSH 登录信息（密码同时用于 sudo 注入） | `22` |
| Compose 目录 | 服务 yaml 所在目录（`~` 可用） | `~/radiance-compose` |
| 默认 Compose 文件 | 面板默认选中的服务文件 | `flashnext-tp2.yaml` |
| Radiance 镜像名 | 「更新镜像」动作 pull 的对象 | `stilldeadcode/radiance` |
| 功率限制 (W) | 「开启限制」设置的目标瓦数 | `210` |
| 需要 sudo | 关闭后所有命令不带 sudo（远端用户需直接有 docker/AMD 权限） | 开 |

> ⚠️ 安全提示：SSH 密码以**明文**保存在本机 `~/.dsh/dsh-local-radiance-server-controller.json`，请勿在共享/受管机器上使用；建议该账号仅授予所需最小权限。

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 排障：| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 报错或行为与代码不符（如引用旧模块缓存） | 重启 DSH 应用 |
| `sudo: a password is required` | 检查设置里的密码（sudo 用的就是登录密码）；改过密码后重新保存 |
| 小部件数字为 `-` 但服务正常 | 服务器重启/断线冷却期内属正常，最长约 30 秒自动恢复 |
| 下拉列表没有某个 yaml | 仅显示 `.yaml/.yml` 且不含 `..` 的常规文件名；`common.yaml` 被刻意隐藏 |
| 解码数字空闲时为 0/很小 | radiance 上报的是引擎口径的窗口均值，空闲本就接近 0 |

dsh-local-radiance-server-controller README · 文件结构：```
dsh-local-radiance-server-controller/
├── index.js          # Host 半区：HTTP 端点 + SSH 连接池 + 全部远端动作
├── client.js         # Client 半区：面板 UI + 侧栏图标 + 实时指标小部件
├── cordis.patch.yml  # Loader 补丁（注入插件条目）

Host 对外端点（本机 DSH web server 前缀路由，受 DSH 登录鉴权保护）：
`GET state`、`GET job?id`、`GET fast`、`POST settings`、`POST action {action,file?}`，
前缀 `/dsh-local-radiance-server-controller`。
